reviews.text: I loved it because it's been two weeks since I brought him home and he still smells wonderful. Kenzo was clearly overjoyed because the time it took us to find him, he wasn't in a cage. Another thing I loved was that they took their time with him, since he's a Pomeranian and they can't rush things because it could damage his coat.

This week I took my cat to get some terrible mats removed, and the service was truly incredible! My cat is quite skittish and wouldn't let me remove her dreadlocks at home, so I searched the entire neighborhood looking for a groomer who could help. Some said they might have to sedate her, which would mean an extra cost, plus having to find a vet to do everything. Others even asked for blood tests... until I found this wonderful place that offered to try! And they succeeded!!! I'm so happy! I would definitely recommend them for cats, dogs, and anything else, because the way they treated pets was exceptional! I definitely give them a 10+!!!

They come out looking beautiful and are always so happy to be there. I've included a photo so you can see how adorable they are. They're also thrilled to be adding a doggy daycare, which will make everything so much easier, since we can leave them while we work or go shopping. Come and check it out; you'll love it. She pampers the little ones.

I've taken my Bichon Maltese (a 6-month-old puppy, Bella, and an 11-year-old) to Katia. The little one started with Katia at 4 months old. She does a fantastic job grooming them; I don't have to say much for her to know what I want from my pets. I highly recommend Katia; you won't regret it.
